systems.owner: Internet Society South Sudan Chapter (implementation lead)

note: Internet Society (Nov 2025) says the chapter is leading implementation of the country's first IXP with technical assistance planned for Q4; not yet in service, so no fact.

facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse's Internet Resilience Index (PCH and PeeringDB data, July 2025) scores South Sudan 0/100 on IXP coverage of population centres and 0/100 on peering efficiency, the share of networks peering at an IXP, so no operating exchange point is shown.

note: The page is for SIXP in Sudan (SDN), not South Sudan; no fact for SSD.
Names Starlink gateways peering at exchanges in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria only; nothing on an exchange in South Sudan.
